faqs.a: Cape Coral and nearby towns like Fort Myers, North Fort Myers, Bonita Springs and Lehigh Acres. Call and we will let you know.

faqs.q: How much does pressure washing cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the job and the surfaces. Send us a few details and you get a clear price before any work starts.

faqs.q: Is soft washing safe for my roof and siding?
faqs.a: Yes. Soft washing uses low pressure and a cleaning solution, so it lifts algae and stains without damaging roofs, stucco or siding.

faqs.q: How often should I pressure wash my home?
faqs.a: In Florida most homes do well with a wash about once a year, since heat, rain and humidity make algae and mildew come back fast.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during the service?
faqs.a: Not usually. We just need outdoor water access and clear access to the areas being cleaned. We will confirm the details when you book.
